description: Searches US federal, state, and municipal law by topic or keyword (legality, permits, zoning, licensing, compliance, filing requirements). Returns ranked provisions with verbatim citations, headings, snippets, and node ids. `jurisdiction` limits results to one state, federal law, or a city.

jurisdiction.description: Optional short code to scope the search, e.g. 'TX', 'US', or 'CA-SF'. Valid codes are listed by law.list_coverage. Includes the jurisdiction's sub-jurisdictions.

mode.description: Retrieval mode. 'hybrid' (default) fuses vector similarity with keyword search.

query.description: Natural-language or keyword query, e.g. 'distillery permit requirements'.

name: law.search

isError.description: True when the tool could not complete successfully.

text.description: Human-readable tool result (also mirrored in content[].text).

title: Search US law
